subject: maths
question: Two athletes X and Y are jogging on a circular path whose circumference is 500 m. Athlete X jogs at a speed of 18 km/h and Y jog at 9 km/h, jogging in opposite directions. The time at which they will meet for the first time is:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Athlete X = 18 km/h

Speed of Athlete Y = 9 km/h

Circumference of circular path = 500 m

**Formula used:**

Relative speed = Speed of X + Speed of Y

Time to meet = Distance / Relative speed

**Calculation:**

Relative speed = 18 km/h + 9 km/h = 27 km/h

⇒ 27 km/h = 27 × (5 / 18) = 7.5 m/s

Time to meet = Distance / Relative speed

⇒ Time = 500 / 7.5 = 66.66 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
